IGUI_SO_ProximityPrompt: Make your sacrifice to The Dark Lord. Choose wisely and may He have mercy on your soul.
IGUI_SO_SacrificeTooltip: Consumes all altar contents and nearby animal carcasses. Accepted sacrifices (any one):
IGUI_SO_SacrificeTooltip_CorpseRepeat: Sacrificing the same player will bore His Holiness over time.
IGUI_SO_SacrificeTooltip_SelfCorpse: Never offer your own corpse. The Dark Lord will take his due from your living flesh.
IGUI_SO_SacrificeTooltip_Animal: Full intact animal carcasses in or around the altar and butchered animal heads in the altar. Carcass size changes XP restore value.
IGUI_SO_SacrificeTooltip_Quality: Rare items: damage, breakage, and partly filled or empty clips reduce recovery strength. Perfect items and full clips give the maximum recovery strength.
IGUI_SO_SacrificeTooltip_Upgrade: Per life: animal offerings add recovery up to the rare-item ceiling; rare-item offerings add recovery up to 100. Further attempts invoke wrath.
IGUI_SO_SacrificeTooltip_Prize: You will be rewarded for sacrificing another player's corpse.
IGUI_SO_InvalidOffering: The Dark Lord does not find your offer acceptable
IGUI_SO_SuccessItem: The Dark Lord accepts your offering. You gain %1 recovery strength; this life's total is now %2.
IGUI_SO_SuccessCorpse: Well done, my child. The corpse raises this life's recovery strength by %1 to %2.
IGUI_SO_SuccessCorpsePrize: Well done, my child. His Holiness rewards your brutality.
IGUI_SO_Wrath: You have insulted the Dark Lord. Feel his wrath!
IGUI_SO_MinorWrath: The Dark Lord has granted all the animal tribute this life will buy. He marks your greed in flesh.
IGUI_SO_GreedWrath_1: I granted your due. Reach again, and I take payment in flesh.
IGUI_SO_GreedWrath_2: Your greed mistakes My Altar for a marketplace. Now you bleed.
IGUI_SO_GreedWrath_3: Enough. The hand that grasps beyond its share will learn pain.
IGUI_SO_GreedWrath_4: You bring tribute only to feed your greed. Now your blood is the offering.
IGUI_SO_GreedWrath_5: Did you think Hell owes you? I collect the debt from your flesh.
IGUI_SO_GreedWrath_6: You have crossed the measure. Feel my Wrath!
IGUI_SO_GreedWrath_7: Your hunger for power exceeds your worth. I shall balance the scales with pain.
IGUI_SO_GreedWrath_8: Greed is a sin. Kneel and be punished.
IGUI_SO_RitualBroken: Your connection with the underworld is broken. Nothing is recovered.
IGUI_SO_RelicTheft: These blades belong to the Dark Lord. The sky splits open to answer your greed.
IGUI_SO_SelfCorpse: You offer your own corpse? The Dark Lord takes his due from your living flesh and opens your throat.
IGUI_SO_ZoneOverlap: Satanic Temples cannot overlap another managed zone.
IGUI_SO_ClaimOverlap: This claim cannot overlap a Satanic Temple.
IGUI_SO_ZoneInvalid: The Satanic Temple bounds are invalid.
IGUI_SO_NotAuthorized: You are not authorized to edit Satanic Temples.
IGUI_SO_NoRecoveryAvailable: No lost skill XP is available to recover.
IGUI_SO_NoRecoveryUpgrade: This offering is not stronger than the recovery tier you already redeemed during this life.
IGUI_SO_AltarBusy: Another offering is already being judged.
IGUI_SO_TooFar: Move closer to the sacrificial altar.
IGUI_SO_FireNotLit: The temple campfire must be lit.
IGUI_SO_InternalError: The ritual falters. Check the server log.
IGUI_SO_RemoveAllTemplesConfirm: Remove all %1 Satanic Temples and their fixtures? Per-account recovery data is kept. This cannot be undone.
IGUI_SO_TemplesPurged: All Satanic Temples and their fixtures have been removed.
IGUI_SO_CorpseNoRoom: This altar half does not have enough room for the corpse.
